nauru.description: Nauru is a small island country in Micronesia, northeast of Australia. It has a tropical climate and limited freshwater resources.
nauru.name: Nauru

pampas.description: The Pampas is a vast fertile lowland region in South America, primarily in Argentina and Uruguay. It is known for its temperate grasslands and agricultural productivity.
pampas.name: The Pampas

mojave_desert.description: The Mojave Desert is a desert in the southwestern United States,  It is characterized by arid conditions and unique desert flora and fauna.
mojave_desert.name: The Mojave Desert

greenland_coast.description: Greenland's coastal tundra is a cold, treeless region with permafrost and limited vegetation. It is home to unique Arctic wildlife.
greenland_coast.name: Greenland (Coastal Tundra)

amazonas.description: The Amazon Rainforest is a vast tropical rainforest in South America, known for its incredible biodiversity and dense vegetation.
amazonas.name: Amazonas

southern_finland.description: Southern Finland is characterized by boreal forests, lakes, and a cold climate. It supports a variety of wildlife adapted to the northern environment.
southern_finland.name: Southern Finland

great_dismal_swamp.description: The Great Dismal Swamp is a large swamp in the southeastern United States, known for its wetlands, diverse wildlife, and historical significance.
great_dismal_swamp.name: Great Dismal Swamp

south_african_savanna.description: The South African Savanna is a tropical savanna biome characterized by grasslands, scattered trees, and a diverse range of wildlife, including large herbivores and predators.
south_african_savanna.name: South African Savanna

mount_everest.description: The Mount Everest Region is a high-altitude area in the Himalayas, known for its extreme cold, ice-covered peaks, and limited vegetation.
mount_everest.name: Mount Everest Region
